map.📖 查看「雾（能见度）生成条件 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Fog (Visibility) Formation Conditions User Guide"
map.雾按能见度分级：能见度低于 1 km 为雾、1 至 10 km 为轻雾；形成条件: Fog is graded by visibility: visibility below 1 km is fog and 1 to 10 km is mist; the formation condition is that near-surface air is nearly saturated (relative humidity close to 100%) and the air temperature drops near the dew point, i.e. the difference between air temperature and dew point does not exceed 2°C; radiation fog mostly occurs on clear nights with light wind (wind speed 1 to 3 m/s) and on autumn/winter mornings, while advection fog forms when warm moist air flows over a cold surface; the smaller the temperature-dew point difference, the denser the fog.
map.📚 深度解析：气象发电适配评估: 📚 In-depth: Meteorological Power Generation Suitability Assessment
map.风光互补电站按当地气象资源估发电量。: Wind-solar hybrid plants estimate generation by the local meteorological resources.
map.由资源等级定装机容量与储能配置。: Determine the installed capacity and storage configuration from the resource grade.
map.对比不同月份出力做调度。: Compare output across months for dispatch.
map.某地年均风速 6 m/s（风功率≈133 W/m²）+ 年辐照 1500 kWh: A site with an annual mean wind speed of 6 m/s (wind power ≈133 W/m²) + annual irradiation 1500 kWh/m²; with wind-solar complementarity, wind in winter and solar in summer make the annualized utilization hours flatter than a single source.
map.日均出力波动系数 0.4，配储能=日均电量×0.4 可削峰填谷，提升自发自用率。: With a daily mean output fluctuation coefficient of 0.4, storage = daily average energy ×0.4 can peak-shave and valley-fill, improving the self-consumption rate.
map.风冬强夏弱、光夏强冬弱，天然互补，平滑出力曲线、降储能成本。: Wind is strong in winter and weak in summer, and solar the opposite; they naturally complement each other, smoothing the output curve and reducing storage cost.
map.资源等级怎么定？: How is the resource grade determined?
map.风能看风功率密度分级，光能看年总量（如 III 类资源区），两者独立评估后组合。: Wind energy is graded by wind power density and solar by the annual total (e.g. Class III resource area); the two are assessed independently and then combined.
